provenance_note: Metrics are MEASURED on the frozen set; economics are ASSUMPTION.

target_dev_auto_precision.justification: Placeholder automation quality bar until the M3 business model computes breakeven precision. The release gate (breakeven plus 0.03) is checked separately on the frozen set; this value only selects the threshold on dev.

tuning.note: Dev also calibrated the classifier, so dev precision is optimistic.

monthly_volume.justification: A mid-sized retail bank's written support queue (chat and secure messages). Chosen to make per-case economics visible, not taken from any real bank.

manual_handling_minutes.justification: Time for an agent to read a message, pick the queue, and tag it without help. Triage only; resolving the request is out of scope and unchanged by this system.

review_minutes.justification: Time for an agent to confirm or correct a suggested route. Shorter than manual handling because the suggestion and the policy reason are shown.

loaded_labor_rate.justification: Fully loaded cost of a support agent, including benefits and overhead. Placeholder for a figure finance would supply.

misroute_cost_standard.justification: Rework when a standard request lands in the wrong queue: a second agent touch, a transfer, and a slower resolution.

misroute_cost_sensitive.justification: A fraud or lost-card report that sits in the wrong queue risks further losses, reimbursement, and complaint handling. Deliberately high; sensitive cases should never auto-route under the policy, so this mostly prices residual risk.

infrastructure_monthly.justification: Allocation for hosting, storage, monitoring, and on-call share for one managed app. Not a quote; M6 measures actual GCP spend for the demo deployment.
